function.name: calculate_Bond_Price
function.description: Calculate the bond price given the face value, coupon rate, required rate of return, and maturity period. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

Face_Value.description: The face value of the bond. This is a float type value.

Coupon_rate.description: The coupon rate of the bond. This is a float type value.

Required_return.description: The required rate of return on the bond. This is a float type value.

maturity_years.description: The number of years to maturity of the bond.

message.content:
我目前無法直接連接到實時市場數據源，因此無法提供「今天」的即時金價。若您需要最新的金價資訊，建議參考以下可靠來源：

| 資料來源 | 特色 |
|----------|------|
| Bloomberg、Reuters | 提供全球金融市場即時報價與新聞 |
| Kitco、GoldPrice.org | 專門追蹤貴金屬價格，更新頻率高 |
| 美國商品期貨交易委員會（CFTC）或紐約商品交易所（COMEX）官方網站 | 官方期貨合約價格與歷史資料 |

如果您想快速查看今日金價，可在搜尋引擎輸入「今日金價」或「gold spot price today」，通常會顯示最新的即時報價。祝您投資順利！
message.reasoning: The user asks: "今天美國的黃金價格是多少？" (What is today's gold price in the US?). We need to provide the current price. We don't have real-time data. We can approximate or say we don't have real-time data. But maybe we can use an external API? There's no tool for fetching live data. So we should respond that we cannot fetch real-time data. We can suggest checking reliable sources like Bloomberg, Reuters, or market websites. Also we can mention typical price ranges. But we can't give exact current price. So answer accordingly.
